put.description:
Enable or disable an executor. Orchestrators lease nothing onto a disabled one (their
reports never re-enable it); runs already placed on it are not cancelled here.

Record executor-conformance and/or security-suite results (plan §8.4). The dispatcher
places verified and public tenants on an executor only while both reports passed for the
caps it currently reports and neither has expired (``MAPI_EXECUTOR_EVIDENCE_MAX_AGE_S``).

Flip kill switches. Enforced at run creation and by the dispatcher at lease time.

Pausing untrusted execution holds new work only. ``cancel_untrusted_runs`` also cancels
every unfinished run of tenant-uploaded code (the reconciler then stops their
executions): the containment step for a suspected sandbox escape.

get.description: Stored policies (tier defaults apply where none is stored).

post.description: Create a tenant; ``initial_admin_email`` is invited as its tenant admin.

patch.description:
Change a tenant's name, tier, status or residency. Suspended tenants are read-only;
``deleting`` tenants are inaccessible (their data is removed by a separate procedure).

get.description:
Cost by tenant for one UTC period (from the ledger) and the current spend against the
global spend cap. Summed in the database: the ledger is never loaded row by row here.

Signed, generation-pinned URL for ``data.zarr.zip``/``schema.json``/``profile.json``/
``preview.json`` (15 min, HTTP Range works).
``…/preview``, ``…/schema``, ``…/profile``, ``…/summary``: 307 to the signed URL.

Who is calling, and the tenants, projects and roles they can act in. For a token:
only its own project (its scopes narrow every role shown).

Signed URL for a bundle object or ``ui/…`` view, minted only after the signed bundle
manifest verifies (``INTEGRITY_FAILURE`` otherwise). Audited.

A sanitized PlotSpec — render it only in the plot-sandbox origin. The manifest is
verified first, and the stored spec is re-sanitized on the way out.
Precomputed ``ui/`` views (summaries, thin draws, grids): 307 to a signed URL.

307.description: Redirect to a signed URL of the precomputed view

post.description:
Score with replayed preprocessing. ``Prefer: wait=N`` (≤ 60) waits up to N s:
200 with output links if the run finished, else 202 with the run.

Run the server-side plot sanitizer on a user-authored PlotSpec (200 even when it is
unsafe: the verdict is ``valid`` + ``issues``).

get.description: Every project the caller can act in, across its tenants (ordered by tenant, id).

The selected project (its tenant comes from ``X-Mapi-Project``, the token, or the
caller's only tenant).
``Accept: text/event-stream`` → live SSE; anything else → a JSON page of events.
Captured lines, oldest first. ``line`` is untrusted text: render it as text only.

Plots a succeeded run rendered (``plots.json``), passed through the plot sanitizer on
every read; plots it rejects are left out. Empty while the run is not ``succeeded``.

The control plane decodes nothing but this size-capped JSON, read at the generation the
finalizer verified.

post.description:
Idempotent: ``cancelling``, or the terminal state if the run already finished.

A ``finalizing`` run is left alone (the response shows it still finalizing): its
execution is over, and cancelling would only throw away a complete result after the
finalizer reserved a version number and copied write-once bundle objects.
Re-queue a ``partial`` run from its checkpoints (new attempt).
A *new* run from a failed one (optionally one resource class up or a new seed).

get.description: An exported JSON Schema, e.g. ``modelspec.json`` (drives Monaco and JSON Forms).

post.description: Store revision 1 (invalid documents are stored too, with ``valid: false``).

get.description: What changed from ``against`` (default: the previous revision) to ``revision``.

post.description: Explicit sandboxed dry-run: the same as ``POST /v1/runs`` with ``kind: validate``.
200 even for invalid documents: the verdict is ``valid`` + ``issues``.

get.description: Tenants the caller belongs to (operators: use ``/v1/admin/tenants`` for all).
The tenant's audit log, newest first (tenant admins).

delete.description:
Delete an empty project (its memberships and tokens go with it). 409 while it holds
datasets, specs, runs or models, and for the platform's default project.

get.description: Project grants plus tenant-wide grants (which apply to every project).
Cost of the whole tenant (tenant admins).
The caller's tokens in the project, newest first (``all=true``: everyone's).

post.description: Mint a token in the selected project; ``secret`` is returned now and never again.

delete.description: Revoke a token (idempotent). The next request with it is ``401``.

get.description: Cost of the selected project for one UTC period, and the quotas in force now.
